name: Log + Deadlift Peak
subtitle: 31 October 2026 competition peak
notes: The empty competition log is 80 kg, so every log warm-up and work set starts at 80 kg or above. Warm-up stretches are brief and movement-focused before heavy lifting. Saturday support work is mixed strongman training with one log focus, a deadlift exposure where appropriate, and low-fatigue carries/loading. Longer relaxed stretching belongs after training or in separate recovery work.
